title: Fairness Cream vs Brightening Cream: An Honest Explainer
ex: No cream can safely change your natural skin colour. Here is what brightening realistically means, the risks of unregulated creams, and a safer routine.
rt: Fairness Cream vs Brightening Cream: The Truth | Mirc Glow
rd: Fairness cream vs brightening cream, honestly explained: why no cream can change skin colour, the risks of steroid or mercury creams, and safer care.
quick: No cosmetic cream can safely change your natural skin colour. A brightening cream aims for fresher, more even-looking skin, helping tanning and spots look less noticeable over 8 to 12 weeks with daily sunscreen. Avoid unlabelled creams promising fast change, as some have contained steroids or mercury.
facts: Natural skin colour is set mainly by your genes.
Cosmetic ingredients can only help extra pigment, like tanning and spots, look less noticeable.
Some unregulated creams have been found to contain steroids or mercury.
Mirc Glow does not sell fairness creams or make fairness claims.
